title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
responsibilities: Design and develop highly available cloud infrastructure services.
Build distributed systems capable of operating reliably across large-scale cloud environments.
Design software components with strong guarantees around scalability, availability, security, and performance.
Investigate and resolve complex infrastructure and networking problems.
Lead architecture and technical design for major infrastructure initiatives.
Work with engineers across networking, security, storage, compute, and application platform teams.
Improve deployment, monitoring, testing, and operational processes for production systems.
Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across the engineering organization.
description: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our cloud infrastructure organization. The engineer will design and operate highly available distributed services supporting large-scale applications. The role requires strong systems and networking fundamentals, software architecture experience, and the ability to lead complex infrastructure initiatives from design through production deployment.
